definitions.gloss: compilation episode; best-of edition; recap episode
definitions.explanation: A special episode or edition that compiles highlights, key scenes, or the best content from a series, show, or publication.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}は{総集編|そうしゅうへん}です。
examples.english: Next week is a recap episode.

examples.japanese: {前半|ぜんはん}の{総集編|そうしゅうへん}が{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: A compilation episode of the first half was broadcast.

examples.japanese: アニメの{総集編|そうしゅうへん}{映画|えいが}が{劇場|げきじょう}{公開|こうかい}されることになった。
examples.english: A compilation movie of the anime series is going to be released in theaters.

notes:
A compound of {総集|そうしゅう} (compiling together) and {編|へん} (volume, edition). Very common in the context of TV dramas, anime, and variety shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総集編|そうしゅうへん}を{放送|ほうそう}する: to broadcast a recap episode
- {総集編|そうしゅうへん}{映画|えいが}: compilation movie
- {年末|ねんまつ}{総集編|そうしゅうへん}: year-end compilation
- {前半|ぜんはん}の{総集編|そうしゅうへん}: first-half recap

USAGE:
In anime and TV dramas, a {総集編|そうしゅうへん} is sometimes aired between story arcs to give the production team extra time, or at the end of a season to recap the story. While some fans see them as filler, {総集編|そうしゅうへん} movies that rework TV anime for the big screen have become a popular format in the anime industry.
